descripcion: SoniCloud Recorder SDK is an open-source reference project for integrating BLE recorder hardware across Android, iOS, HarmonyOS, Flutter, Windows, and macOS. It includes SDK examples, recording control, real-time audio, file transfer, offline transcription, protocol tools, and vendor adaptation support.
